verdicts.rationale: Implement-first fails: the note frames this as a renderer gap ('findCastSummon picks summons[0] only'), not a wireable data primitive — adding a second summon to summons[] would not render, so a reviewer cannot author it. Purpose test then fails too. The only thing omitted is minor off-field Geo resonance DMG from a second/co-spawned Stone Stele; the single-stele sub-row 'first-cast rendering is correct.' The decision-relevant Hold-E outputs — the Jade Shield summon and the -20% all-element resShred window — are modeled and reachable on the Hold variant. Zhongli is a shield-support; stele resonance DMG drives no rotation decision, and the divergence only surfaces in the narrow multi-stele scenario. (Aside: both notes say 'C2 max 2 steles' but the max-2-steles buff is actually C1 — a curator-note error, not a timeline divergence.) Default noCaveat holds.
rubricRefs: CANNOT model / constitution exclusion: damage numbers-math
Purpose test: 'silently omits something decision-relevant' — stele resonance DMG is not decision-relevant
Never describe working behavior — single stele renders correctly

groundedIn.claim: The gap is a renderer limitation (picks the first summon only), and the single stele is rendered correctly — so it is not data-authorable and single-cast rendering is not a divergence.
groundedIn.quote: Multi-stele spawning (C2 max 2 steles, Hold-E spawning a stele alongside Jade Shield) is not modelled — the renderer's findCastSummon picks summons[0] only. The first-cast rendering is correct; subsequent casts on the same input refresh the same sub-row.

groundedIn.claim: The decision-relevant Hold-E output — the Jade Shield carrying the -20% all-element RES debuff — is authored and reachable on the Hold variant.
groundedIn.quote: Lives on the Hold-E variant so the shield-active gate is naturally scoped: only fires when Hold-E is cast (which is what creates the Jade Shield carrying the -20% all-element RES debuff to nearby enemies).

groundedIn.claim: The Hold-E co-spawned stele is deliberately not rendered because the variant summons[] shows only the Jade Shield; the omitted item is the stele.
groundedIn.quote: Hold E also creates a Stone Stele alongside the Jade Shield. Variant summons[] overrides base, so only Jade Shield is rendered here — the timeline does not show a co-spawned stele on Hold-press.

groundedIn.claim: The Stone Stele's only output is intermittent Geo resonance DMG — a minor off-field source, not a rotation-decision driver.
groundedIn.quote: Additionally, it will intermittently resonate with other nearby Geo constructs, dealing Geo DMG to nearby opponents.
